{{Short description|Swedish chemist (born 1947)}}
[[Professor]] '''Gunnar Svedberg''' (born 12 August 1947 in Annefors, [[Bollnäs Municipality]]) is a former [[Rector (academia)|Rector]] of the [[University of Gothenburg]], in [[Sweden]].

Svedberg studied at the [[Royal Institute of Technology]] (KTH) in [[Stockholm]] and received a [[PhD]] in [[chemical engineering]] in 1975. He became a full professor at the KTH in 1989. He was the Rector (corresponding to Vice-Chancellor or President) of [[Mid Sweden University College]] from 1999 to 2003, and of the [[University of Gothenburg]] between July 2003 and September 2006. He was President of [[Innventia]], until his retirement in June 2011.
 
Svedberg has been a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]] since 1992.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20111007040519/http://www.ivawebb.se/Members/member_detail.asp?offset=40&ID=229 Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences: Svedberg, Gunnar]</ref>
